title: Emberveil Class (v1)
description: One playable class. Canonical source: public/data/classes.json (classes[]). Mirrors the BASE CLASSES literal in src/game/classes.js BEFORE the derived `unlockRequirement` + `tags` keys are attached at module load (those are recomputed in classes.js, not stored here).

id.description: Stable class id — referenced by saved heroes (member.class). NEVER rename.

svgIcon.description: Inline SVG markup for the class icon. This IS data.

appearance.description: Optional — appearance/sprite id reused when the class has no dedicated sprite set.
